name: Margaret Gardient
role: Young Medora woman, married at Bismarck in May 1885
bio: Miss Maggie Gardient was named in March 1885 among the entertainers for a Stockmen's ball at the Pyramid Park hotel, and in April she won first prize among the ladies at a masquerade skating contest. She was married at Bismarck in May 1885; the paper named her as the daughter of Joseph Gardient of New Richland, Minn.
